name: Risk-Adjusted (Sharpe-Ratio) Momentum (full universe)
description: Cross-sectional momentum ranking assets by trailing Sharpe ratio (mean/std of returns) rather than raw past return (Rachev, Jasic, Stoyanov & Fabozzi 2007). Holds the top N equal-weighted with an absolute-momentum gate to VUTY when trailing Sharpe is non-positive. Distinct from raw-return MomentumTopN and vol-scaled-sign TimeSeriesMomentum.
